about_the_game:
Place tiles, maximize your score, and surpass the level threshold to progress. Roguelike gameplay, mind bending challenges, and hand-crafted puzzles await!

Strategic Gameplay, Satisfying Solutions

Tile Trials is a roguelike puzzle game where layouts become more complex and your tiles improve as you progress. In each level, you must surpass a score threshold to continue your run. Earn bonus points for satisfying layout constraints and acquire powerful new tiles from the market to build the perfect hand.

Hundreds of Roguelike Levels

Explore hundreds of unique layouts, designed to steadily introduce new mechanics, score challenges, and strategic opportunities. Every level is a stepping stone to mastery, rewarding your growing skills with increasingly satisfying solutions.

Six Unique Challenge Trials

Change the way you play with special challenge trials that introduce new rules and mechanics. From timed challenges, to golf style scoring, these trials offer a fresh twist on the core gameplay and push you to think in new ways.

Thirty Hand-crafted Puzzles

Puzzles are hand-crafted levels with a specific set of constraints and available tiles. Ranging from easy, deduction based solutions to hard, Sudoku-like puzzles that will test your skills in achieving the maximum possible score under the harshest conditions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHZ
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Not required

short_description: Tile Trials is a tile-placing, number based puzzle game for the casual strategist. Place a variety of familiar shapes onto increasingly difficult layouts to maximize your score and surpass each threshold. Roguelike gameplay, mind bending challenges, and hand-crafted puzzles await!
